changed: The server package ships no profile any more (D4, ADR 0026). src/e_agent/server/profiles/fixture.json moved with git mv (content unchanged) to src/e_agent/plugins/erp/simulator/fixture_profile.json, a resource of the simulator wheel; e_agent.plugins.erp.simulator.fixture_profile_path() returns its path using importlib.resources only (no fake_erp or scenarios import). server/profile.py load_profile(path=None) now loads the given path, else the path in E_AGENT_PROFILE, and otherwise raises KernelError STARTUP_REJECTED 'no profile given: pass --profile or set E_AGENT_PROFILE', which the CLI prints as 'error STARTUP_REJECTED: ...' with exit 2 instead of a traceback; the CLI --profile help names E_AGENT_PROFILE and no longer mentions the fixture. Nothing under src/e_agent/server imports the helper. The Playwright backend (ui-conformance playwright.config.ts) passes --profile with the fixture path; the Makefile maps an empty PROFILE= to the fixture profile (FIXTURE_PROFILE), so make dev PROFILE= keeps its scripted-driver behaviour; README and docs/runbooks/demo.md export E_AGENT_PROFILE before the fixture commands. New tests in tests/unit/server/test_profile_location.py: test_load_profile_requires_path_or_env, test_env_profile_is_used (an explicit path wins over the environment), test_server_package_ships_no_profile, test_no_caller_uses_the_implicit_default (scans 184 .py files under src/, tests/ and scripts/, excluding itself, prints the count and fails on zero).
